title: BlissPointWell
label: Healthcare Private Practice Website
summary: A calm, trust-forward healthcare website designed to support patient confidence and clear service navigation.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: BlissPointWell is a private mental health practice website designed to establish trust, clarity, and professionalism for prospective patients. The site prioritizes simplicity, accessibility, and a reassuring tone.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.body: Healthcare websites often suffer from unclear hierarchy, cluttered layouts, and weak mobile usability—issues that reduce confidence and credibility in sensitive contexts.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.body: A clean, minimal system focused on information hierarchy, calm visual rhythm, predictable navigation, and mobile-first responsiveness—removing friction rather than adding features.

sections.title: Key Features
bullets: Trust-forward design system with restrained typography and spacing
Clear service presentation in plain language

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A composed, professional healthcare website that supports patient confidence and serves as a stable foundation for future growth.

sections.title: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Clarity and restraint outperform complexity in trust-sensitive environments.

cta.headline: Interested in a similar project?
cta.body: If you're building a healthcare or service website that needs to feel calm and credible, I'd be happy to review your project.
